topics.title: Collect data: Collect discrete data; organise using tally charts and tables

questions.stem: Tally the vehicles that are parked in or near your school. Using the completed school car tally table, what was the most popular make of vehicle around the school?

questions.hint: Count the tally marks in each row (remember a crossed bundle of tally marks equals 5) and find the row with the largest total.

keyPoints.note: The most popular make is the one with the greatest number of tally marks.

questions.solution: Holden has \(1\) bundle of \(5\) plus \(2\) extra tally marks (\(5 + 2 = 7\)), which is the highest count in the table.

steps.explain: Recall how to read tally marks: each crossed group of tally marks represents \(5\), and single strokes represent \(1\) each.
